purpose: Defines the design of the ADR writer: the write-adr skill, adr-writer custom agent, and adr_exchange.py script that record decisions into one ADR file per feature.
summary: Three-part architecture: inheriting write-adr SKILL entry point, isolated adr-writer custom Agent, and adr_exchange.py handoff script
Design rationale: why an Agent, why a SKILL entry, one ADR file per feature, rejection handled by rewriting the same section
adr_exchange.py subcommands open, request-path, finish, check with request fields, input files, and exit codes 0/1/2
Target ADR file resolution by existing ADR file count and verdict-to-file-state consistency checks
adr-writer agent spec: tools allowlist, write boundary limited to the ADR file, required reading, handling by kind
write-adr SKILL flow: output dir resolution, content organization, numbering, request publish, agent launch, verdict branching, completion
Verdict is a closed set of three values (created, rejected, insufficient) recorded by the script; reasons returned as natural language
Normative documents to change: adr_principles_spec, adr_usage_spec, adr_format, doc_structure_format
Use cases and sequence diagram with error flows for open, finish, and check failures
Test design: unit tests for the script, lint for agent tools and contract wording, manual evaluation tests
tasks: Writing tests and lint for the ADR writer
title: DES-085 ADR ライター 設計書
